injection_details.method: Code cave injection: VirtualProtectEx(PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE=0x40) -> WriteProcessMemory(payload) -> VirtualProtectEx(PAGE_EXECUTE_READ=0x20) -> CreateRemoteThread(cave_addr) with fallback to NtCreateThreadEx (resolved at runtime via GetModuleHandleA("ntdll.dll")+GetProcAddress, DesiredAccess=THREAD_ALL_ACCESS 0x1fffff) -> WaitForSingleObject(5000ms) -> CloseHandle
injection_details.target_discovery: No process enumeration; target handle obtained directly from GetCurrentProcess(), and the module image base for code-cave scanning from GetModuleHandleA(NULL)
injection_details.cave_location: Executable section (IMAGE_SCN_MEM_EXECUTE) of the module's own PE image; scans for a run of >=0x30 0x00/0xCC padding bytes or the section VirtualSize/SizeOfRawData slack

encryption_details.algorithm: 1) Repeating-key XOR over the 48-byte injected payload; 2) Custom 'AES-128-like' byte transform using the standard AES S-box (10 rounds: state[i] = SBOX[state[i]] ^ key[i] ^ (27*round)) applied to a 16-byte block - NOT textbook AES (no MixColumns/ShiftRows/key schedule)

encryption_details.key_storage: Hardcoded in .rdata: g_xor_key at RVA 0x140004000, g_aes_key at RVA 0x140004120, AES S-box g_aes_sbox at RVA 0x140004020; encrypted payload (g_encrypted_shellcode, 48 bytes) at RVA 0x140003000 and encrypted 16-byte block (g_encrypted_block) at RVA 0x140003030 in .data
